description: This file contains centralized API error handling utilities, including exception mapping, and a method to register global exception handling middleware for a web application.

classes.name: ApiErrorHandling
classes.description: A static class providing utilities for centralized API error handling, including middleware registration and exception-to-result mapping.

methods.name: UseUnifiedExceptionHandling
methods.description: Extension method to register global exception handling middleware that converts uncaught exceptions into consistent ProblemDetails responses.

methods.name: ToResult
methods.description: Converts an exception into an HTTP result with a ProblemDetails body, including logging based on the severity.

methods.name: MapException
methods.description: Maps specific exception types to appropriate HTTP status codes and problem details information, including handling Postgres exceptions.
